caption: The drawing features a single teapot centrally positioned on a light beige background. The teapot has a rounded body with a wide base resting on a pedestal-like foot, a curved spout on the left, and an ornate, scroll-shaped handle on the right. The lid is domed with tiered, concentric shapes and a finial at the top. Shading is used to depict the three-dimensional form of the teapot, primarily in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance. In the upper left corner, there is an inset sketch in black lines showing a simplified outline of the same teapot with height and width measurements labeled as "11 1/8" and "10 1/2." The artist's signature, "H. Maralian," is located in the bottom right corner. The entire composition is enclosed within a thin rectangular border.
title: Pewter Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
